question: With what do you divide thrust in a liquid to obtain the value of pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Area__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thrust is defined as the force acting perpendicular to the surface of an object.**
 
• The formula of thrust:
 
• Thrust = Pressure × Area

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mass** is defined as the amount of matter in a substance.
 
• **Density** is defined as the ratio of the mass per unit volume.
 
• **Volume** is defined as the quantity of three-dimensional space occupied by a liquid, solid, or gas.
